content: FFmpeg release cadence as of Aug 2026: 7.x superseded; 8.0 'Huffman' released Aug 2025, 8.1 'Hoare' released Mar 16 2026, 9.0 'Lei' released Aug 4 2026 (9.0.1 Aug 12 2026), bumping libavcodec/libavformat to the 63.x series. AVChannelLayout (new API) was introduced FFmpeg 5.1/6.0 era; the legacy uint64_t channel_layout mask field (FF_API_OLD_CHANNEL_LAYOUT) was fully removed in FFmpeg 7.0 (Feb 2024) — so any FFmpeg >=7.0 target must use AVChannelLayout exclusively.
